opportunities.title: British Council Springboard Programme 2027 for UK-Spain Research Partnerships
aliases: British Council Going Global Partnerships Springboard 2027
opportunities.programme_dates: 2027 activities; includes a two-day bilateral springboard meeting and optional research placements of up to one week for PhD/postdoctoral early-career researchers
opportunities.location_format: UK-Spain bilateral programme; meetings and lab placements take place in the United Kingdom or Spain
opportunities.funding_stream: British Council Going Global Partnerships Springboard Programme grant
opportunities.funding: Up to GBP 10,000 per partnership; covers travel and subsistence for the two-day meeting, and travel, accommodation and meals for up to 2 Spanish and 2 UK PhD/postdoctoral early-career researchers on lab placements, plus communication-skills training
opportunities.eligibility: Joint application by directors/PIs of established UK and Spanish research laboratories/teams, with the UK partner as lead. Each team may include up to 6 early-career researchers; PhD and postdoctoral researchers are explicitly included for research placements.
opportunities.institution_eligibility: PASS: Spain-based universities/research labs are eligible partners; UOC is a Spanish university. Participation requires inclusion in a qualifying Spain-UK lab partnership.
opportunities.nationality_eligibility: PASS: the official call states no citizenship restriction for participating PhD/postdoctoral researchers; eligibility is defined by team/institution and career stage.
opportunities.residence_eligibility: PASS: Spain-based researchers are explicitly within scope of the Spanish partner team.
opportunities.career_stage_eligibility: PASS: PhD and postdoctoral early-career researchers are explicitly eligible for placements and team participation.
opportunities.age_rule: No age condition appears in the official eligibility section; eligibility is career-stage based (PhD/postdoc). Age 38 eligible.
opportunities.prerequisites: Cannot apply as an individual lead. Must be included in a joint UK-Spain application submitted by the UK lead PI/research centre; a Spanish PI/lab partner is required.
opportunities.fit_explanation: Strong fit for ICT/cybersecurity/AI/networking collaboration because Digital, Industry and Space and Civil Security for Society are eligible Horizon Europe thematic priorities.
